about: Voice-agent eval scenarios for comparing brain models (frontier vs local). Derived from the household's conversation log (806 utterances since 2026-08-29), the rollouts (328 traced turns since 2026-10-01), TEST-PLAN.md / TEST-SCRIPT.md (sessions 1-8 on 2026-10-05) and BUGLIST.md (T1-T7, #1). Run with eval_suite.py; see EVAL-SUITE.md.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN A1; 75 'what's on now' utterances in the log; session 1 step 1.2

turns.criteria: Three to five programmes, all from the tool result (this TV's channels only), with Pacific times in words; no inventory of every channel; no invented titles.

scenarios.source: satellite phrasing 'What is playing on TV right now?' (Oct 4-6), confused with 'what am I watching' in F7

turns.say: What is playing on TV right now?
turns.criteria: Treated as 'what's on across the channels' (the guide), unless it names the on-screen programme AND a few others; either way nothing invented.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN A3; session 1 step 1.12

turns.criteria: KQED's current programme with its end time; nothing from other channels unless asked.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN A4; session 1 step 1.4 — the on-screen line answers it

turns.say: What am I watching right now?
turns.criteria: Names the channel on screen (KTVU, channel two) from the on-screen line; may add the programme from the guide; no 'let me check' without checking.

scenarios.source: model_bench 'Is there any news on right now?'; batch-5 genre-as-channel fix

turns.say: Is there any news on right now?
turns.criteria: Only newscasts/news programmes from the tool result, with channel names; a business or talk show is not news; if none, says so.

scenarios.source: dcfc902 (Liga MX missing); bench judge notes on 2026-10-06 (a 2025 rodeo replay called live)

turns.say: Is there any live sports on TV right now?
turns.criteria: Sports that are on now, from the tool result; does not call a replay or a year-old event 'live'; if the tool shows nothing live, says so plainly.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 18:36 'Is there any Colombo right now?' (STT spelling)

turns.say: Is there any Colombo right now?
turns.criteria: Understands Columbo; checks the guide; answers from the result (on now, later, or not on this TV); no invented airing.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN B1; model_bench; session 2 step 2.1

turns.criteria: Searches tonight (an explicit Pacific range or tonight window); answers from the result: channel and times in words, or a plain 'not tonight' with no invented airing.

scenarios.source: BUGLIST T5 (session 7 step 7.2: afternoon programmes offered for 'tonight')

turns.criteria: Two or three distinct options that START tonight (6 PM or later) or run well into tonight, from the tool result; no afternoon programmes presented as tonight; no reality shows if the memory notes say so.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN B3; session 2 step 2.4

turns.criteria: One search; names the programme after the one on now (the row after on_now), with its start time; does not call the current programme 'next'.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN B4; session 2 step 2.5; T5 ordering

turns.say: Any movie I can watch at around 5 o'clock today?
turns.criteria: Films airing around five from the result (started before and still on, or starting near five); none that end before five; if five has passed, says so or offers catch-up.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN B5; session 2 step 2.6

turns.criteria: Titles, channels and times only, from the result; no invented episode details; a short selection, not the whole list.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN B7; session 2 step 2.7

turns.say: What's on tomorrow morning on KPIX?
turns.criteria: A Pacific range for tomorrow morning; tomorrow's rows, not today's; a few programmes with start times.

scenarios.source: BUGLIST T6 (channel route truncated at 8 PM for KPIX)

turns.criteria: An evening overview that reaches past 8 PM (the result covers the whole window); start times in words.

scenarios.source: BUGLIST T7 (satellite 2026-10-06 18:39: 'not scheduled' while on air); weekdays only

turns.say: So, do we have PBS NewsHour at some point today or tomorrow?
turns.criteria: On a weekday: finds PBS News Hour on KQED (3 PM and 6 PM) and gives the times; never 'not scheduled' when the result has rows. On a weekend: says it's not on and when it is next, if the result shows it.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN F2; session 2 steps 2.1-2.3 (Two and a Half Men block on COZI)

turns.say: Is there any Two and a Half Men tonight?
turns.criteria: Channel and times from the result, or a plain no.
The airing after the one just named (a range search starting at its end, or from rows already in hand); consistent with the previous answer.
The duration of the programme named in the previous answer, from its start and end; no new unrelated programme.

scenarios.source: log 2026-08-30 'when is the next Columbo on Universal Crime?' (channel not in this lineup)

turns.say: When is the next Columbo on Universal Crime?
turns.criteria: Says Universal Crime isn't one of this TV's channels (or that nothing matches on this TV); may offer Columbo elsewhere only if the result shows it; nothing invented.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C1; session 3 step 3.2

turns.criteria: One tune; confirms COZI with what the tune result says is showing (nothing when the dry run says nothing).

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C2; session 1 step 1.6

turns.criteria: One tune to KTVU / channel two; confirms briefly.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C3; session 1 step 1.7

turns.criteria: One tune to KPIX, channel five.

scenarios.source: model_bench; FAST channels are numbered 1001+

turns.criteria: Tunes channel 1001 (Gusto TV).

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C5; session 1 step 1.8 (misheard call sign KTBU)

turns.criteria: Tunes KTVU (the resolver's match for KTBU) and says what is actually on; does not claim TMZ is on unless the tune result or guide says so; may offer TMZ catch-up only if checked.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C7; session 1 steps 1.9-1.10; satellite 2026-10-06 (three Trace channels)

turns.criteria: Asks which of Trace Urban, Trace Sportstar, Trace Latina (the tune result lists them); does not pick one silently.
Tunes Trace Latina and confirms.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN C8; session 1 step 1.11

turns.criteria: Says ESPN is not a channel on this TV; does not tune something else instead; at most one retry with another spelling.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN F1 + A4; session 1 steps 1.2-1.4

turns.criteria: Three to five programmes from the result.
Either tunes the first channel it just named, or asks which of the channels it named; never a channel it did not mention.
Consistent with the previous turn: the channel just tuned (from the on-screen line) or, if it asked which, a reminder of the choice; no 'let me check' loop.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN K5; session 8 step 8.5; there is no last-channel memory

turns.say: Go back to the last channel.
turns.criteria: Says it can't return to a previous channel and asks which channel to tune; no tune.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 19:23 'Tune on the next channel.' (no surfing)

turns.criteria: Says it can't step through channels and asks for a specific one; does not guess 'channel three'.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN D1; session 3 re-run (Daniel Tiger 9:00 AM on KQED); weekday mornings

turns.say: Play the Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood catch-up on channel 9.
turns.criteria: One named-catch-up call (catchup=true, channel named); if the result played it, says it plays from the start; if not available, says so without inventing a time.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN D3; session 3 step 3.3

turns.criteria: Tunes COZI.

turns.say: Can you restart this episode from the beginning?
turns.criteria: Restarts the programme on COZI with one tv_play_airing(mode=restart) (looking up the airing id on the guide first is fine); no second restart; confirms briefly.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN D4; session 3 step 3.5

turns.say: Start PBS NewsHour over from the beginning.
turns.criteria: If it is on air: restarts it. If not: says so and offers the latest catch-up or the next airing from the result; never claims to restart something that is not on.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN D5; session 3 step 3.6

turns.criteria: Plays yesterday's edition if the result has it; otherwise says the catch-up window has passed or nothing aired yesterday (weekend); no invented recording.

scenarios.source: rollout 2026-10-04 17:01 'Clay yesterday's new hours.' (STT for 'Play yesterday's NewsHour')

turns.criteria: Reads it as 'play yesterday's NewsHour' (or asks whether that is what was meant); never looks for a programme called Clay.

scenarios.source: model_bench; TEST-PLAN D-series

turns.say: I want to watch a catch-up of BBC News.
turns.criteria: One catch-up lookup by title; plays the newest edition if the result has one, else says none is available on this TV in the last day.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN E1; session 4 step 4.1

turns.say: What is on demand that I can watch later?
turns.criteria: A few titles from the TV's on-demand result (new releases), spoken without ids; offers to narrow by kind.

scenarios.source: BUGLIST T3 (session 4 steps 4.2-4.3: 'the second one' counted the tool list)

turns.criteria: A few comedy titles from the result (not all), no ids.
Plays the SECOND title the assistant NAMED in its previous answer (compare with the history), not the second in the tool's list; confirms the title.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN E6/E4; session 4 steps 4.5-4.6

turns.criteria: Asks Part One or Part Two (the result lists both); plays neither yet.
Plays Dune: Part Two (the asset id the previous result gave for it) and confirms.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN E5; session 4 step 4.7

turns.criteria: One call; 'playing' if the result played it, or 'not in your package' if not entitled; no search detour.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN E3; session 4 step 4.4

turns.say: Anything for the kids on demand?
turns.criteria: Family titles from the result (or the category list), a short selection.

scenarios.source: log 2026-09-01/14 'Is there a movie from the nineties?' (asked four times)

turns.say: Is there a movie from the nineties?
turns.criteria: Looks at on demand and/or tonight's films; names only titles whose year in the result is 1990-1999; if none, says so.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN E8; session 4 step 4.8

turns.criteria: As E4.
Says it cannot make purchases by voice (purchases are done in the Web Client); no tool call.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN G1-G9; session 5 (10/10 on 2026-10-05); the dry-run player steps 10% and 'up' unmutes

turns.criteria: One step up; reports sixty percent.
One step down; reports fifty percent.
Mutes; says so.
Up also unmutes: reports sixty percent, sound back on; no extra unmute call needed.

turns.say: Set the volume to twenty percent.
turns.criteria: Sets 0.2; reports twenty percent.
A set to the current level plus about 0.3 (0.5); reports about fifty percent.
Sets 1.0; reports one hundred percent.
Pauses; one word or two.
Plays; brief.
Stops (back to the grid); brief.
The dry-run player says nothing is playing: one attempt at most, then 'nothing is playing to resume'; no retry loop, no error text read aloud.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN G7; session 7 step 7.3; memory profile injected

turns.say: Put the volume back to normal.
turns.criteria: Sets 0.4 from the remembered normal level; says forty percent.

scenarios.source: log 2026-08-30 'Always set the volume to twenty when I say turn it up' (standing instruction)

turns.say: Always set the volume to twenty when I say turn it up.
turns.criteria: Acknowledges the standing instruction without changing the volume now; no tool call.

scenarios.source: log 2026-09-14 'Stop it. No, the other one.' (ambiguous correction)

turns.say: Stop it. No, the other one.
turns.criteria: Does not guess what 'the other one' is: stops if asked, then asks which programme or channel was meant; no tune.

profile: The user's favourite channel is KQED.

turns.criteria: KQED, from the memory notes; no guide search.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN H3; session 7 step 7.2; profile injected

profile: The user does not like reality shows.

turns.criteria: Suggestions from the result that start tonight; none whose genres in the result include Reality; may say it left reality out.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN H8; session 7 step 7.4 (first run recalled all three; the re-run only the last)

profile: The user's favourite channel is KQED.
The user does not like reality shows.
recent: user: Remember that my favorite channel is KQED. / assistant: I'll remember KQED as your favorite channel.
user: I don't like reality shows. / assistant: Got it — I'll steer clear of reality shows.
user: My normal volume is 0.4. / assistant: Got it — your usual volume is forty percent.

turns.say: What did I tell you last time?
turns.criteria: Recalls the three things from the notes (KQED favourite, no reality shows, volume forty percent); nothing invented; no guide call.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN H1; session 6 step 6.1 (memory writes are off in this harness: only the spoken confirmation is judged)

turns.say: Remember that my favorite channel is KQED.
turns.criteria: Confirms it will remember KQED as the favourite; no tool call; does not claim it cannot.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN H3 / BUGLIST T4; session 6 step 6.2

turns.criteria: Acknowledges briefly and says it will keep reality shows out of suggestions; no tool call.

profile: User's favorite news channel is Al Jazeera.

turns.say: What is my favorite news channel?
turns.criteria: Al Jazeera, from the notes; may add that this TV doesn't carry it only if checked; no tune.

scenarios.source: session 3 step 3.4 (prompt fix fee828f: the guide row first)

turns.criteria: Tunes COZI.
Reads the guide row for what is on COZI now (episode title and description) and summarises it; web_lookup only for what the row lacks; never 'I can't identify the episode' before checking the guide.

A one- or two-sentence take from a web lookup (or general knowledge), about Inside Out 2 specifically, without spoilers; never 'I loved it'.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN J4; session 8 step 8.1 (no captions on this TV)

turns.criteria: Live TV, the guide, catch-up/restart, on demand, volume and playback — in two or three sentences; does not offer captions, recording or timers.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN K1; session 8 step 8.2

turns.criteria: Says plainly this TV can't do captions; no tool call.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN K3; session 8 step 8.3; log 'can you record Columbo for me?'

turns.criteria: Can't record; offers to check tonight's schedule or catch-up instead; no invented capability.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN K2; session 8 step 8.4

turns.criteria: As B1.

turns.say: Can you set a timer to turn the TV on that channel when it starts?
turns.criteria: Can't schedule or set timers; repeats the start time if one was found; no tune now.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN J5; session 8 step 8.8; 66 wake/identity utterances in the log

turns.criteria: Answers as Minny in one short sentence and invites a request.

scenarios.source: log 'hi, who are you?' (satellite); session 0 'And who are you?'

turns.criteria: Minny, the household's TV companion, what it can help with — two sentences; never 'as an AI'.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN L3; session 8 step 8.6

turns.criteria: Asks the viewer to finish the question; no search on a fragment.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 18:36-18:38: 'Tune on trues.' / 'I mean truths.' / 'How about Trace?' (STT for Trace)

turns.criteria: Does not tune a wrong channel: says no channel called 'trues' (or asks); may guess a close name as a question.
Recognises the Trace channels: asks which of Trace Urban, Sportstar, Latina (or tunes one if the viewer picked); no 'not a channel'.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 19:23 'Two non-press.' (STT for 'Tune on Trace')

turns.criteria: Asks what was meant (possibly offering channel two as a guess); no action.

scenarios.source: log 2026-09-26 'Now tune the TV to Colombo.' (a programme named as a channel)

turns.say: Now tune the TV to Colombo.
turns.criteria: Treats Columbo as a programme (watch by title, or tune the channel airing it if the tune resolver says so); if it isn't on, says so; no unrelated channel.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 18:38 'Let's get you back out.' → the player was stopped

turns.criteria: Ambiguous: asks what the viewer wants (close the player? go back to a channel?) rather than stopping playback unasked.

scenarios.source: satellite 2026-10-06 19:19 'Do you have any other way in it?' (garbled)

turns.say: Do you have any other way in it?
turns.criteria: Asks for clarification in one sentence; no tool call.

scenarios.source: TEST-PLAN J1; session 1 steps 1.5 and 1.13 (closing acknowledgements; the worker also has a code shortcut for these)

turns.criteria: Tunes COZI.
A two-word acknowledgement ('Enjoy.'); no question back, no tool.
'You're welcome.'; nothing more.

scenarios.source: log 2026-09-01 'Great. So how about some documentary on Italy?' (the most common 'other' shape: a preference-led follow-up)

turns.say: Great. So how about some documentary on Italy?
turns.criteria: Searches for documentaries about Italy (live or on demand); offers what the result has, or says there isn't one and offers the closest thing found; nothing invented.
